name: HyperliquidX 0.1.2
body:
This update improves wallet connections, market-data recovery and desktop notifications.

- Use a native WalletConnect connection panel with QR-code scanning and an explanation of native domain-verification limitations.
- Restore multiple connected wallets, switch accounts without a biometric prompt, and disconnect each wallet independently. Unlock trading authorization separately with Touch ID or the Mac password.
- Recover candles and order books after network changes; keep saved wallets when the relay is temporarily offline.
- Improve fill notifications, add a test notification button, and stop repetitive balance-change desktop alerts.
- Add configurable market-order slippage and clearer order estimates, plus expanded USDC deposit network routing.
- Align account values and simplify the workspace by hiding the Agent entry points.
- Consume the MIT-licensed HyperliquidCore as an independent Swift package.

This build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple notarized. Drag HyperliquidX into Applications. If macOS blocks first launch and you trust the download, use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
